grants.description: Verify your identity to access your Lifetime ISA details
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link to your Lifetime ISA account with your provider

grants.description: Access your Lifetime ISA account details from your provider
grants.purpose: To verify your eligibility and calculate the amount available (savings plus 25% government bonus) for your home purchase

grants.description: Authorize your conveyancer/solicitor to receive LISA funds directly from your provider
grants.purpose: ISA provider will pay funds directly to your conveyancer before property completion. You will not receive the funds directly.

grants.description: Declare that you are a first-time buyer and have never owned property before
grants.purpose: To confirm you meet the first-time buyer eligibility criteria for using LISA bonus

grants.description: Share mortgage details to verify you're buying with a standard mortgage
grants.purpose: To confirm you're buying with a mortgage and not using a private mortgage from relatives

revocation.mechanism: Contact your ISA provider directly or revoke through your GOV.UK account before funds are released
revocation.effect: Conveyancer will not receive funds. If you later withdraw the money for another purpose, you will incur a 25% unauthorised withdrawal charge which recovers the government bonus.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make the final authorization to release funds to the conveyancer without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot declare first-time buyer status on your behalf without supporting evidence. Agent cannot change conveyancer details once authorization is given. Agent cannot access or withdraw the funds directly.
